description:
RemediationPolicy says which actions are allowed, on which targets, within which bounds, and whether a human
must approve. Its generation is part of every plan digest, so changing it invalidates pending approvals.
The name must be a DNS label (at most 63 characters), since requests reference it.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

actions.description:
actions the policy allows, at most one entry per type. MaxItems follows the size of the action catalog;
keeping it small keeps the CEL cost of the bounds rules within the API server's budget.

items.description: PolicyAction allows one action type within bounds. Exactly the bounds member named by type is set.

max.description: max is the highest maxReplicaCount the policy allows.

maxDecreasePercent.description: maxDecreasePercent limits one decrease relative to the previous value; 0 refuses every decrease.

maxIncreasePercent.description: maxIncreasePercent limits one increase relative to the previous value.

min.description: min is the lowest maxReplicaCount the policy allows.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: min must not be greater than max

max.description: max is the highest memory limit the policy allows.

maxDecreasePercent.description: maxDecreasePercent limits one decrease relative to the previous value; 0 refuses every decrease.

maxIncreasePercent.description: maxIncreasePercent limits one increase relative to the previous value.

min.description: min is the lowest memory limit the policy allows.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: min and max must be whole bytes
min must not be greater than max
adjustKedaMaxReplicas must be set if and only if type is AdjustKedaMaxReplicas
setContainerMemoryLimit must be set if and only if type is SetContainerMemoryLimit

approval.description: approval says whether human review is always required.

gitOps.description: gitOps limits where changes may be made.

allowedPaths.description: allowedPaths are glob patterns of files the policy may patch. The resolved file must match one.

items.description:
GitPathPattern is a glob, relative to a repository root, for files a policy may patch. `*` matches within one
path segment and `**` across segments; neither matches a segment that starts with a dot. The first segment
must be literal, so a pattern cannot cover the whole repository, and no segment may start with a dot or a
dash.

repositoryRef.description: repositoryRef names an entry in RemediationSettings spec.repositories.

requestNamespaces.description:
requestNamespaces are the namespaces whose RemediationRequests may use this policy. A request from any
other namespace is Denied, so being able to create requests somewhere does not grant this policy.

items.description: Name is a DNS label used to reference other Shadewright objects or entries.

namespaces.description: namespaces the policy covers. Required: there is no "all namespaces".

items.description: Name is a DNS label used to reference other Shadewright objects or entries.

objectSelector.description: objectSelector further limits targets by label.

matchExpressions.description: matchExpressions is a list of label selector requirements. The requirements are ANDed.

items.description:
A label selector requirement is a selector that contains values, a key, and an operator that
relates the key and values.

key.description: key is the label key that the selector applies to.

operator.description:
operator represents a key's relationship to a set of values.
Valid operators are In, NotIn, Exists and DoesNotExist.

values.description:
values is an array of string values. If the operator is In or NotIn,
the values array must be non-empty. If the operator is Exists or DoesNotExist,
the values array must be empty. This array is replaced during a strategic
merge patch.

matchLabels.description:
matchLabels is a map of {key,value} pairs. A single {key,value} in the matchLabels
map is equivalent to an element of matchExpressions, whose key field is "key", the
operator is "In", and the values array contains only "value". The requirements are ANDed.

status.description: status is reserved; no controller writes it yet.

conditions.description:
conditions are reserved. Nothing writes them yet: an unknown repositoryRef is not reported here but
refuses the requests that use the policy (reason RepositoryNotInPolicy).

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.
This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description:
message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.
This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.
Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field,
and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API.
The value should be a CamelCase string.
This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

observedGeneration.description: observedGeneration is the generation the status describes.
